mapper.select:
SELECT gd.group_deal_id AS groupDealId, NULL AS productId, -- GROUP_DEAL 테이블에는 product_id 없음
-- 카드에서 보여줄 이름을 공동구매 제목으로 사용 gd.title AS productName, -- 예: "제주 감귤 5kg 공동구매" NULL AS region, -- 산지 정보는 현재 매핑 테이블 없으므로 null NULL AS mainTag, -- 태그 컬럼 없음 → null
-- 이미지도 아직 상품 테이블과 연동 안 하므로 null NULL AS imageUrl,
-- 가격 정보 (GROUP_DEAL 기준) gd.origin_price AS originPrice, gd.deal_price AS dealPrice, gd.discount_rate AS discountRate,
-- 현재 참여 인원: 팀들의 current_member_cnt 합계 ( SELECT NVL(SUM(t.current_member_cnt), 0) FROM GROUP_DEAL_TEAM t WHERE t.group_deal_id = gd.group_deal_id AND t.status IN ('WAITING', 'FULL', 'SUCCESS') ) AS currentMemberCount,
gd.min_member_count AS minMemberCount, gd.end_at AS endAt,
-- 평점/리뷰수: 아직 PRODUCT 연동 안 했으므로 0으로 고정 0 AS rating, 0 AS reviewCount FROM GROUP_DEAL gd WHERE gd.status = 'OPEN' AND gd.is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY gd.end_at ASC

SELECT gd.group_deal_id AS groupDealId, NULL AS productId, -- GROUP_DEAL에는 product_id 없음 NULL AS detailId, -- detailId도 테이블에 없음
-- 상세 화면에서 보여줄 이름/설명: GROUP_DEAL 컬럼 사용 gd.title AS productName, -- 카드/상세에서 공통으로 사용할 이름 gd.group_deal_detail AS groupDealDetail, -- 상세 설명 (있는 경우)
-- 가격 정보 gd.origin_price AS originPrice, gd.deal_price AS dealPrice, gd.discount_rate AS discountRate,
gd.min_member_count AS minMemberCount, gd.max_member_count AS maxMemberCount, gd.per_user_limit_qty AS perUserLimitQty,
gd.start_at AS startAt, gd.end_at AS endAt,
-- 현재 참여 인원: 팀들의 current_member_cnt 합계 ( SELECT NVL(SUM(t.current_member_cnt), 0) FROM GROUP_DEAL_TEAM t WHERE t.group_deal_id = gd.group_deal_id AND t.status IN ('WAITING', 'FULL', 'SUCCESS') ) AS currentMemberCount,
-- 판매 수량: 참여 멤버 수 기준 (PENDING_PAYMENT, PAID) ( SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM GROUP_DEAL_MEMBER gm JOIN GROUP_DEAL_TEAM t ON gm.team_id = t.team_id WHERE t.group_deal_id = gd.group_deal_id AND gm.status IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'PAID') ) AS soldCount,
-- 평점/리뷰수: 상품 테이블과 아직 안 묶였으므로 0으로 고정 0 AS rating, 0 AS reviewCount,
-- 배송 정보/판매자 이름: 현재 PRODUCT/PRODUCER와 연동 안 했으므로 null NULL AS deliveryText, NULL AS sellerName,
-- 상품 코드: group_deal_id를 문자열로 사용 TO_CHAR(gd.group_deal_id) AS productCode FROM GROUP_DEAL gd WHERE gd.group_deal_id = #{groupDealId}

SELECT group_deal_id AS groupDealId, title, sub_title AS subTitle, group_deal_detail AS groupDealDetail, origin_price AS originPrice, deal_price AS dealPrice, discount_rate AS discountRate, min_member_count AS minMemberCount, max_member_count AS maxMemberCount, per_user_limit_qty AS perUserLimitQty, start_at AS startAt, end_at AS endAt, status, is_active AS isActive, created_by AS createdBy, created_date AS createdDate, updated_date AS updatedDate FROM GROUP_DEAL WHERE group_deal_id = #{groupDealId}
mapper.update: UPDATE GROUP_DEAL SET status = #{status}, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE group_deal_id = #{groupDealId}
mapper.select: SELECT image_id AS imageId, group_deal_id AS groupDealId, image_url AS imageUrl, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_date AS createdDate FROM GROUP_DEAL_IMAGE WHERE group_deal_id = #{groupDealId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, image_id ASC
